senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; כָּסַס) [marking off, counting,) toll, tax.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 33b:5">Sabb. 33ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 2b:9">Ab. Zar. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>תקנתם גשרים ליטול בהם מ׳</he> you put up bridges in order to raise toll on them.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 13a:2">Ib. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>יניח לו את המ׳</he> to him shall the toll be remitted. Tanḥ. Lekh 5 <he>טלו מ׳ של חטין</he> collect the duty as if it were wheat; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מִכְסָאוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 28:4">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXVIII</cite>.
